findings.finding: AC4's 'Any-count grep over src/rebar/attest/*.py still reports exactly 2' rests on an unquoted grep whose result I cannot reproduce as '2': a plain substring search for `Any` over that directory returns 8 hits, 6 of which are docstring/comment prose ('Any lookup problem', 'Any parse/shape problem', 'Any failure'). Only registry.py:62 and :89 are type-position `Any`. Because the split introduces a NEW module whose docstrings will carry the same recurring fail-closed idiom ('Any git/lookup failure'), a naive grep count will change even though real type-annotation Any usage does not — the AC's measurement is under-specified and can false-fail or false-pass.
findings.location: AC line 'the Any-count grep over src/rebar/attest/*.py still reports exactly 2'
